package dailyassignments;

public class FindEvenAndOdd {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		
		/*
		 * Count Even and Odd Numbers
			Write a Java program to count how many even and odd numbers are present in an integer array.
			Input:
			{11, 24, 35, 42, 56, 67, 80, 93}
			Expected Output:
			Even numbers: 4
			Odd numbers: 4
		 */
		
		int[] arrNum = new int[8];
		arrNum[0] = 11;
		arrNum[1] = 24;
		arrNum[2] = 35;
		arrNum[3] = 42;
		arrNum[4] = 56;	
		arrNum[5] = 67;	
		arrNum[6] = 80;	
		arrNum[7] = 93;
		int EvenCnt = 0;
		int OddCnt = 0;
		
		for(int index = 0;index<arrNum.length;index++)
		{
			if(arrNum[index]%2==0)
			{
				EvenCnt++;
			}
			else
			{
				OddCnt++;
			}
		}
		
		System.out.println("Even number count is:"+EvenCnt);
		
		System.out.println("Odd number count is:"+OddCnt);
		
	}

}
